rules.text: The mid-air moves listed under the table (most jump abilities, plus wall_cling and screw_kick) share one slot for their mid-air code: Sonic 1/2 keep only the last one in the list, and no character has tried two in the other games. Use ability_cycle to switch between several jump abilities. double_jump, water_swim and hover aren't in that slot.
rules.source: tools/abilities.py functions(): one air function per character (air_of)

rules.text: hover only follows jet_dash, rocket_ride or ear_grapple; on its own it does nothing.
star_grab takes the jump-ability state and slots 41-43 for itself: only physics alongside it, and no shot or melee.
head_throw takes the jump-ability state and slots 41-43 for itself: only physics alongside it, and no shot or melee.
anchor_throw takes the jump-ability state and slots 41 / 43: only water_walk, no_breathing and physics alongside it, and no shot or melee.
free_swim takes the jump-ability state and slots 41-43: only no_breathing and physics alongside it, no shot or melee, and swim_dirs 8.
free_flight takes the jump-ability state and slots 41-42: only no_breathing and physics alongside it, no shot or melee, and loop_points 6 to 12.

voltteccer takes the jump ability, its state and slot 41: alongside it only melee, magnetic, no_breathing, fire_immune and physics (a shot / shot2 on Y is fine), no ability_cycle, and the art's charge_palettes for its charged flash.
water_swim draws its stroke in slot 47, which ray_glide and wall_cling use too.
In Sonic CD water_swim's timer and slot are shared with spin_attack, high_kick, thunder_zip and power_surge (and with puddle_slide plus a dash-type move).

In Sonic CD the Shadow Sink's timer is shared with many moves: sink can't be combined with ray_glide, ear_grapple, spirit_flight, triple_jump, wall_cling, power_surge, charge, spin_attack, high_kick, water_swim, puddle_slide, phase_warp, melee_cooldown or ability_cycle.

In Sonic CD the Phase Warp's direction and speed share values with ray_glide, wall_cling, puddle_slide, spin_attack, high_kick, thunder_zip, power_surge, water_swim, aim_dash, ear_grapple, triple_jump, spirit_flight, charge (and a down + Y shot).

In Sonic CD high_kick's values are shared with ray_glide, aim_dash, ear_grapple, spirit_flight, triple_jump, wall_cling, power_surge, thunder_zip, puddle_slide, charge, spin_attack and melee_cooldown.
In Sonic CD ground_slide shares its value with pogo, and puddle_slide has its own slide code.
In Sonic CD no_stomp's Slide (with ground_slide) breaks walls through the byte fire_immune, breaks_walls and charge's juggernaut mark use.
In Sonic 1/2 no_stomp's Slide (with ground_slide) breaks monitors through NoSwap_flags' surging bit, which power_surge and charge use.
In Sonic CD fire_immune shares one byte with breaks_walls and with charge's juggernaut mark.
In Sonic CD a shot's pose shares its value with ray_glide.
With puddle_slide, the melee needs melee_cooldown (the slide holds Y off through it).

ability_cycle: 2 to 4 different moves of double_jump, screw_kick, jet_dash, umbrella, each also in "abilities"; the melee on Y with no melee_cooldown; no hover, no umbrella_attack; screw_kick only with kick_jump.
swap_shots needs monitor_swap and no "shot" / "shot2" of its own; swap_icon needs swap_shots; monitor_swap is a list of at most 8 different names.
shot2 needs a "shot" thrown with Y alone (no "input").
A shot with "input" "down" or "up" needs the melee (Y alone stays the melee); "slam" needs hammer_drop.
bat_glide changes Knuckles' own glide: it needs base "knuckles".
rules.source: tools/abilities.py (bat_glide patches the Knuckles glide states)

rules.text: A character built on Tails or Knuckles keeps the base's own move on the jump button: Tails' flight, or Knuckles' glide and climb. A move started by pressing jump again in mid-air can't replace it (Sonic 1, 2 and CD's build stops; S3&K never starts it). Use base "sonic" for such a move, or a move started with Y (aim_dash with aim_dash_y, Charmy's way, keeps the flight on jump); moves on Y, the ground and settings work with any base.
rules.source: tools/abilities.py apply_base_characters; native/src/NoSwapS3K.cpp (base != 0: no ready jump)

rules.text: psycho_grab and melee_whip are parts of the melee (Y): they need "melee" in the list.

melee_run and melee_up are poses of the melee (Y): they need "melee", their frames are slots 45 / 46 (not with aim_dash, melee_whip, charge, psycho_grab, star_grab, head_throw, rocket_burst, free_flight or free_swim), and the melee must be a move of its own (no shot on Y alone, melee_nuke, melee_cost or ability_cycle). Sonic CD keeps the pose in Object[5].Value5: not with wall_cling, ray_glide, ear_grapple, high_kick, triple_jump, puddle_slide, rocket_burst, charge, spin_attack, spirit_flight, water_swim, phase_warp or thunder_zip.
